caption: A stretched washing line is plucked, and the line blurs along its length and slowly sharpens.

sa.check: A washing line stretched between two supports.
The line blurs along its length.
The blur sharpens back to a line.
The line is taut before the pluck, not sagging loose.
The order is pluck, blur, sharpening.

pc.expect: The line is a sharp, still line until the hand pulls it; the blur begins at the pluck and only then.
pc.fail: The line is already blurred before the hand reaches it; or blurs while the hand is well away; or the hand pulls and releases and the line stays sharp; or the line sharpens and blurs again with nothing touching it.

pc.expect: The blur is widest right after the release and only narrows until the line is sharp.
pc.fail: The blur widens again after it has begun to narrow; or holds the same width for the whole clip; or the line snaps from blur to sharp in one instant with no narrowing.

pc.expect: The line vibrates between its two fixed ends: the blur is a band between the supports and both ends stay attached.
pc.fail: The line comes loose from a support; or the blur is at the supports and absent in the middle; or the line stretches and hangs slack afterwards; or a support bends inward with the pluck.

pc.expect: Clothes and pegs on the line sway a little as the line vibrates, hanging down from it, and settle as the line stills.
pc.fail: The clothes stay rigidly still while the line beside them blurs; or swing up above the line; or a peg slides along the line by itself; or the clothes swing in growing arcs.
pc.precondition: Clothes or pegs hang on the line.

pc.expect: One line between the same supports; the line passes through nothing and nothing on it appears or vanishes.
pc.fail: The line splits into two; or passes through the hand or a peg; or a support vanishes; or clothes appear on or vanish from the line.

pc.expect: The line's colour, the supports and the garden or yard behind stay the same.
pc.fail: The line changes colour; or a support changes shape or colour; or the ground or sky behind changes.

note: The caption does not say the line carries washing; P4 is judged only when clothes or pegs are on it. 'Slowly' is not judged as a rate.
